description: This file contains unit tests for the Sending class within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging package. It tests various behaviors of the Sending class, including acknowledgment handling, monitor calls, and response processing.

classes.name: SendingTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the Sending class, verifying its behavior under various conditions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and test fixtures before each test case.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullSendingContext
methods.description: Test that creating a Sending instance with a null SendingContext throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullFuture
methods.description: Test that creating a Sending instance with a null futureResponse throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullLogger
methods.description: Test that creating a Sending instance with a null logger throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: acknowledgeAndMonitorNullCommandResponseWhenShouldAcknowledge
methods.description: Test acknowledgment behavior when the command response is null and acknowledgment is expected.

methods.name: monitorAcknowledgementSendSuccessKeepOriginalResponse
methods.description: Verify that successful acknowledgment leads to the original response being returned.

methods.name: monitorAcknowledgementSendFailureKeepOriginalResponse
methods.description: Verify that a negative acknowledgment results in failure monitoring and the original response is returned.

methods.name: monitorLiveResponseSendSuccessKeepOriginalResponse
methods.description: Test that a successful live response acknowledgment is handled correctly.

methods.name: monitorLiveResponseSendFailureKeepOriginalResponse
methods.description: Test handling of a failed live response acknowledgment.

methods.name: monitorNothingAsShouldNotAcknowledgeAndOriginalResponseIsNull
methods.description: Confirm behavior when no acknowledgment is issued and the response is null.

methods.name: monitorAndAcknowledgeWhenFutureResponseTerminatedExceptionallyAndNoAckLabelIssued
methods.description: Verify handling of exceptional future completion with no acknowledgment label issued.
